name: Marcia E. Bean
prior_offices: Big Horn County attorney (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Marcia E. Bean is the Big Horn County attorney and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The Lovell Chronicle reported that she ran unopposed after winning the Republican primary.
